data.verdict: OFFSET-ZERO LOCATION [scope-(a), honest negative on the substrate reading]. (Q1) The zero-crossing q* is truncation-STABLE at q* = 0.08931 (spread over N>=3 = 7.0e-04), pinned by the quadratic balance 1-9q-28q^2=0 => q_quad=(-9+sqrt(193))/56=0.08737. But it is NOT a substrate quantity: it misses q0-1, hbar_q, hbar_q^2, 1/q0 and the series radius all by >>1% (closest is hbar_q at ~9.9%) — q* is set by the DT expansion's own low-order Stokes coefficients {9,28} (which encode the {3,4} datum), carrying NO independent substrate meaning. (Q3) The offset series CANNOT be evaluated at q0 (q0~1.110 >> radius R~0.57, and q0>1): the partial sums diverge, so the c_3-odd hook via direct q0 evaluation is inaccessible; the q->0 datum o(0)=1 has no clean/derived relation to Q_beta c_3=-2, and nothing is wired. (Q2) The certified o(q)=c+ - c- has o(0)=1!=0, so it is a cross-chirality difference, NOT a bar-covariant f(q)-f(q^-1); its q=1 vanishing is therefore NOT delivered by the bar-fixed-point argument. 'Origin-centred only at q=1' is recoverable ONLY as the TRIVIAL vanishing of any genuinely bar-odd object at the fixed point q=q^-1=1 (already #4577's gate applied to q itself) — a DIFFERENT object from the DT {3,4} offset, which lives at q->0 with its own root at q*~0.089. VERDICT: q~0.08 is the DT-series' own convergence-region root with no substrate meaning; the specific 'DT saddle-offset vanishes AT q=1' claim is REFUTED as an independent reading (scope-(a): a narrowing of the picture, invoking no proved invariant to exclude an ingredient). (Q3-refined, post-steering) The offset coeffs grow GEOMETRICALLY (finite radius ~0.63, geometric R^2 >= factorial R^2): the offset is on the RESUMMED (convergent Stokes-constant Z[q^±]) side of the Borel transform, whereas c_3 is a coefficient of the DIVERGENT perturbative Phi_5_2 (Fantini-Wheeler Borel domain) — opposite sides, so no direct Borel-level offset<->c_3 identity. (Q2-reconcile) The owner's 'centred at q=1' is most naturally a FIBRE-level statement (bar-fixed point of formal q, where a bar-covariant Habiro element vanishes by construction) — consistent with, but a different object from, the archimedean q->0 DT offset this probe measures; q~0.08 is an archimedean-series feature, not a refutation of a fibre-level q=1 centring. No fit; no c_k wired; scope-(a).
